transcript.text: Two people meet in a park for the first time.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Cześć! Mam na imię Anna.
transcript.speaker: Anna

transcript.text: Cześć! Jestem Piotr.
transcript.speaker: Piotr

transcript.text: Miło mi cię poznać.
transcript.speaker: Anna

transcript.text: Mnie też.
transcript.speaker: Piotr

transcript.text: Then they say where they are from.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Jestem z Polski.
transcript.speaker: Piotr

transcript.text: Jestem z Hiszpanii.
transcript.speaker: Anna

transcript.text: To ask a friend, or a child, their name:
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Jak masz na imię?
transcript.speaker: Anna

transcript.text: This question is informal: for one person you know well, or a child.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Mam na imię Anna.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: These three words, then your first name.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Jestem z Polski.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: These two words, then the country.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: The country name changes its ending, so for now, learn these as whole phrases.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Anna says hi and gives her name. What does she say? (pause)
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Cześć! Mam na imię Anna.
transcript.speaker: Anna

transcript.text: Did you say it? Say it once more, out loud.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: They shake hands. What does Anna say? (pause)
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Miło mi cię poznać.
transcript.speaker: Anna

transcript.text: Did you say it? Say it once more, out loud.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Piotr is from Poland. What does he say? (pause)
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Jestem z Polski.
transcript.speaker: Piotr

transcript.text: Did you say it? Say it once more, out loud.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

transcript.text: Now introduce yourself in the exercises below the video.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Marek)

video.objective: Say your name and where you are from, and react when you meet someone.

pedagogy.objective: Say your name and where you are from, and react when you meet someone.

transcript.text: Ola is at home with her cat.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Mam kota.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: There is no word for a. Just: cat.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Kot śpi.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: And no word for the. She means her cat, so in English: the cat.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Mam psa.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: In the park, Ola sees a cat she does not know.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Kot śpi.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: The same words. Here, in English: a cat is sleeping.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Polish has no articles: no separate words for a, an or the.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: At home, she means her cat: the cat is sleeping.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: In the park, any cat: a cat is sleeping.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: When you translate into English, choose a, an or the from the context.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Ola talks about her pet. I have a dog. What does she say? (pause)
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Mam psa.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: Did you say it? Say it once more, out loud.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: What is the cat doing? Say it in Polish. (pause)
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Kot śpi.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: Did you say it? Say it once more, out loud.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Read the examples below the video at your own pace.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

video.objective: Understand that Polish has no articles, and choose a or the in English from the situation.

pedagogy.objective: Understand that Polish has no articles, and choose a or the in English from the situation.

transcript.text: A small café in the morning. Ola would like a coffee.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Przepraszam.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: Excuse me. She wants his attention.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Proszę.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: It means please, when you ask for something.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Proszę.
transcript.speaker: Tomek

transcript.text: It also means here you are when you hand something over.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Dziękuję.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: Proszę.
transcript.speaker: Tomek

transcript.text: And you are welcome when someone thanks you.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: He offers her milk.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Tak.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: And sugar?
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Nie.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: Proszę.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)
transcript.translation: Please. Here you are. You are welcome.

transcript.text: Please, when you ask for something.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Here you are, when you hand something over.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: You are welcome, when someone thanks you.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: One word, three uses. The situation tells you which.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Tomek hands Ola her coffee. What does he say? (pause)
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Proszę.
transcript.speaker: Tomek

transcript.text: Did you say it? Say it once more, out loud.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Ola takes the cup. What does she say? (pause)
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Dziękuję.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: Did you say it? Say it once more, out loud.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Later, in the street. Tomek holds the door open.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Dziękuję bardzo.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: Proszę.
transcript.speaker: Tomek

transcript.text: Przepraszam.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: Same words, a different place. And it can also mean: sorry.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Tomek has his back to her. How does Ola get his attention? (pause)
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Przepraszam.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.text: Did you say it? Say it once more, out loud.
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: He offers milk, and she wants some. What does she say? (pause)
transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.text: Tak.
transcript.speaker: Ola

transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)

transcript.speaker: Narrator (Anna)
